proposals.premise: Extreme close-up of 2B's gloved hand gripping the edge of a crumbling stone ledge as her blindfold slips slightly, revealing the mechanical iris beneath; dust particles float in the air from the recent crack, and her expression is one of sharp focus rather than panic.

Waist-up shot of 2B bracing against a sudden gust of wind from a broken air vent, her puffy sleeves billowing outward while she leans forward to keep her balance; her gaze is fixed on the source of the draft, and her hairband holds her short white hair in place despite the turbulence.

Full-body view of 2B mid-step across a narrow, fractured bridge over a chasm; her weight is shifted dynamically to one leg as she reaches out with her free hand to steady herself against a crumbling pillar, her thigh-high boots gripping the uneven stone surface.

High-energy shot of 2B dodging a falling debris block that shatters behind her, creating a cloud of dust; she is in a low crouch with one leg extended forward, her dress hem flaring up to reveal her stockings, and her eyes are locked on the next incoming fragment.

Wide-angle low shot of 2B standing atop a collapsed skyscraper floor, silhouetted against a harsh industrial sunset; she is actively pulling down a loose cable to secure her footing as the ground beneath her shifts slightly, emphasizing her small scale against the massive ruin.

Close-up of 2B's face as a sudden burst of steam from a ruptured pipe forces her to tilt her head sharply upward; the pressure pushes her short white hair back against the black blindfold, and her gloved fingers are visible at the bottom frame gripping her own wrist in a reflexive brace to counteract the heat shock.

Waist-up shot of 2B leaning over a jagged hole in the floor, her torso twisted to peer into the darkness below; she is holding onto a rusted metal rebar with one hand to steady herself as her puffy sleeve slips slightly off her shoulder, revealing the black glove's cuff, while her expression remains stoic despite the precarious grip.

Full-body view of 2B balancing on a single narrow beam of debris suspended over a glowing reactor core; her legs are crossed at the ankles for stability, and she is carefully placing one boot down onto the next precarious plank while her dress hem flutters in the updraft from the heat source below.

High-energy shot of 2B lunging forward to catch a swinging cable that has snapped free, her body stretched horizontally in mid-air with one leg extended back and the other bent; her black dress billows outward due to the air resistance, and her eyes are locked on the anchor point she is about to secure.

Wide-angle low shot of 2B standing in a vast, dark cavern illuminated only by the bioluminescent glow of alien flora; she is actively pressing her hand against a massive, pulsating organic wall to feel for a vibration, her silhouette framed by the towering, twisting roots above, emphasizing her interaction with the living environment.

Close-up of 2B's face as a fine layer of red dust settles on her black blindfold, causing her to close one eye and tilt her head slightly down; her gloved hand is raised mid-air, fingers splayed but not yet touching the surface, as she inspects the particle drift with intense focus.

Waist-up shot of 2B twisting her torso sharply to the left while gripping a rusted control lever that has jammed; her puffy sleeves bunch up at the elbows from the exertion, and her hairband tilts with the motion as she strains against the mechanical resistance.

Full-body view of 2B arching her back to squeeze under a low-hanging beam of debris, her knees bent and one foot sliding forward on the slick concrete floor; her dress hem catches on a jagged edge below, pulling taut as she forces her torso through the narrow gap.

High-energy shot of 2B spinning in a tight circle to evade a sweeping arc of broken glass, her body leaning into the turn with arms tucked close; shrapnel streaks past her face, and her short white hair flies outward from the centrifugal force while her boots dig into the ground for traction.

Wide-angle shot looking up at 2B as she hangs from a dangling chain in a massive, echoing hall, swinging gently toward a distant wall; her legs dangle freely and her dress flutters around her calves, emphasizing the precarious height and the silence of the vast space below.

Close-up of 2B's face as a sudden spike in ambient temperature causes her short white hair to steam slightly; her black blindfold remains taut and unmoved, but her gloved hand rises sharply to wipe a bead of condensation from the bridge of the fabric, her eyes narrowed with sharp focus on the heat source off-screen.

Waist-up shot of 2B leaning heavily against a collapsing wall section, her shoulder pressing into the debris as she braces for impact; her puffy sleeves compress under the weight, and her expression is one of strained determination rather than fear, with her gaze locked on the shifting rubble above.

Full-body view of 2B climbing a vertical support beam using only her hands and feet, her body pressed flat against the metal surface; her thigh-high stockings grip the rough texture as she pulls herself upward, her dress hem hanging straight down due to gravity, emphasizing the vertical tension of the ascent.

High-energy shot of 2B mid-leap over a spreading fissure in the floor, her body fully extended horizontally in the air; her black dress flares out behind her due to momentum, and her eyes are fixed on the landing spot ahead as dust plumes rise from the cracking ground below.

Wide-angle shot of 2B standing on a suspended platform that is tilting sharply to one side due to a broken cable; she shifts her weight aggressively to the high side to counterbalance, her hair blowing sideways from the air displacement, highlighting the precarious tilt against the vast, dark industrial ceiling.
